Project Name: JetBlue Airlines: 6 years
Client
JetBlue Airlines
Role
Project Lead & developer
Team Size
2
Technologies
SharePoint Online, Office 365 product, SPFX, ReactJS, JavaScript, Node JS, Power Apps, Power Automate, Custom connector, Asp.Net, Azure Services, SQL,
Description: The project is for Airlines domain, specializing in SharePoint, Power Apps and .NET technologies for developing and enhancing internal applications. Skilled in building enterprise portals, workflow automation, crew management solutions, and operations support tools, ensuring seamless collaboration and improved business processes across Airline departments.
Responsibilities:
➢ Designed and developed internal applications for airline operations, including crew scheduling, ticketing support, compliance tracking, and maintenance reporting using ASP.NET, C#, and SharePoint.
➢ Built custom SharePoint solutions (web parts, workflows, and lists, document libraries) to manage
critical airline documentation and streamline internal approvals.
➢ Developed WCF services / REST APIs for integration between airline operational systems and
internal portals.
➢ Implemented SharePoint-based intranet portals for knowledge sharing, flight manuals, and
operational announcements.
➢ Created automated workflows for leave requests, incident reporting, and crew onboarding using
SharePoint Designer / Power Automate.
➢ Developed SPFx Application Customizers to inject custom banners, notifications, and analytics
across airline intranet portals.
➢ Built SPFx Field Customizers to visually represent operational data (e.g., crew status, flight status)
in SharePoint lists.
➢ Implemented SPFx Command Sets for bulk operations like exporting passenger manifests or
triggering workflows.
➢ Integrated SPFx Extensions with REST APIs, Microsoft Graph, and custom .NET services.
➢ Managed ALM for SPFx solutions using Azure DevOps pipelines for CI/CDOptimized existing .NET applications for performance, scalability, and security, ensuring compliance with airline IT policies.
➢ Collaborated with business analysts and airline operations teams to gather requirements and
deliver tailored solutions.
➢ Migrated legacy airline applications into modern SharePoint and .NET frameworks, improving
system reliability and user adoption.
➢ Provided production support and maintenance for critical internal airline applications, ensuring
minimal downtime.
➢ Designed and developed Canvas Apps and Model-Driven Apps in Power Apps to digitize airline/ internal processes such as crew management, compliance tracking, and operational reporting.
➢ Implemented SQL Server, and SharePoint as data sources, ensuring scalable and secure storage
solutions.
➢ Created custom connectors to integrate with REST APIs, WCF services, and Azure Logic Apps,
enabling seamless data flow between internal .NET applications and Power Platform.
➢ Automated workflows and business processes using Power Automate (Flow), including approval
flows, notifications, and system-to-system integrations.
➢ Applied role-based security and environment governance policies for managing app access
and compliance in enterprise setups.
➢ Developed reusable components and templates for faster delivery of multiple apps across airline
business units.
➢ Embedded Power BI dashboards into Power Apps for interactive data visualization and real-time
operational insights.
➢ Worked on ALM (Application Lifecycle Management) for Power Platform using Solutions, Azure
DevOps pipelines, and GIT repositories.
➢ Implemented offline capability in Power Apps for crew operations requiring mobility with
intermittent connectivity.
➢ Collaborated with business users to gather requirements, design wireframes, and conduct UAT
sessions, ensuring adoption and usability.
➢ Optimized app performance using delegation-aware queries, proper data source design, and
formula best practices.
➢ Extended Power Apps functionality using Power Fx formulas, JavaScript, PCF (Power Apps
Component Framework) controls, and custom APIs.
➢ Supported governance and monitoring by configuring Power Platform Admin Center, DLP (Data
Loss Prevention) policies, and analytics.

Description: The Project is for Chennai Metro Rail Ltd, It is Government agent connected with Railways Department in India. The task is assigned to the internal team and they review these documents and goes for approval process. Once the flow is completed based on the time interval expiration policy is applied to the documents and they are disposed from the site. A report generation based on documents uploaded statistics, department-wise reports, Contractor reports,
Responsibilities:

controls was used in displaying rows of data in a customized template format.
➢ Used Generic Collections to retrieve the data ➢ Involved in configuring Search Service and Content database and SharePoint Service database
movements.
Project Name: LNT IDPL | 1 year
Client
LNT IDPL – Chennai, India.
Role
SharePoint Development & Administration
Team Size
2
Technologies
SharePoint 2010, SQL Server 2008 Enterprise & Express, C#.net
Description: The application is for LNT IDPL. It’s approval workflow where users submits their request in the board proposal along with the attachments and submits to approvers. The approver will review the users request and either forward to LS Head or rejects. The rejected proposals goes back to The approved proposals will move to Legal & Secretarial Head, either the LS Head can close the proposal or further move its legal and secretarial independent body. After their review the proposal can either approves or rejects and sends that status back to LS head. Finally LS Head will close the proposal based on the status of independent body. The dashboard serves to count the incoming task proposals to each department. It composes of two module where first module is dedicated to Board proposal, True copy and other services and second module is a legal workflow.
Responsibilities:
➢ Involved in Page design ASP.net page development ➢ Involved in configuring Enterprise search and User Profile and MySite. ➢ Developed various custom webparts, branding, and UI Customization.
➢ Data binding was extensively used to bind various controls to the data from database. Grid View
controls was used in displaying rows of data in a customized template format.
➢ Involved in using ADO.NET to retrieve and send data to database. ➢ Developed SQL stored procedures and functions to interact with the database. ➢ Involved in Unit/Integration testing various modules of the project.

Tech Lead, Trainer & developer
Team Size

Node, Power Apps, Power Automate

Project Name: United Parcel Services: 1.5 years
Client
United Parcel Services
Role
Project Lead and Lead Architect
Team Size
Technologies
GCP - ETL pipelines micro service using Cloud-run, Spanner, Big Query
Description:
As a Seasoned Tech Lead with architecting and delivering cloud-native solutions on Google
Cloud Platform. Expert in designing micro services on Cloud Run, globally-consistent transactional storage
with Cloud Spanner, and robust ETL/streaming pipelines (batch & streaming) to transform and deliver
mission-critical data for analytics and operational systems.
Responsibilities:
➢ Stakeholder’s engagement translate business needs into technical solutions, create project plans
and timelines.
➢ Created detailed BRD, FRD, and micro-service wireframes preparing architectural flow and data
distribution across client-facing retail application.
➢ Performed gap analysis and recommended system enhancements that reduced manual work
➢ Worked in an Agile-Scrum environment, contributing to sprint planning and retrospectives.
➢ Handling team by providing solution and guidelines for code reusability and technical
guidelines, best practices, code reviews, and ensuring adherence to coding standards and
project timelines.
➢ Implemented event-driven ingestion patterns (Pub/Sub → Dataflow → Big Query/Spanner) for
near-real-time processing and derived metrics used by dashboards and operational services.
➢ Defined data modeling and partitioning strategies to optimize Spanner performance and cost
(proper use of primary keys, interleaved tables, and read vs write locality).
➢ CI/CD for containers and infra: Git-based pipelines for Dockers builds, vulnerability scans, Cloud
Build triggers, and automated deployments to Cloud Run with traffic splitting and canary rollouts.
Project Name: JetBlue Airlines: 6 years
Client
JetBlue Airlines
Role
Project Lead & developer
Team Size
Technologies
SharePoint Online, Office 365 product, SPFX, ReactJS, JavaScript, Node JS,
Power Apps, Power Automate, Custom connector, Asp.Net, Azure
Services, SQL,
Description:
The project is for Airlines domain, specializing in SharePoint, Power Apps and .NET technologies for
developing and enhancing internal applications. Skilled in building enterprise portals, workflow
automation, crew management solutions, and operations support tools, ensuring seamless collaboration
and improved business processes across Airline departments.
Responsibilities:
➢ Designed and developed internal applications for airline operations, including crew scheduling,
ticketing support, compliance tracking, and maintenance reporting using ASP.NET, C#, and
SharePoint.
➢ Built custom SharePoint solutions (web parts, workflows, and lists, document libraries) to manage
critical airline documentation and streamline internal approvals.
➢ Developed WCF services / REST APIs for integration between airline operational systems and
internal portals.
➢ Implemented SharePoint-based intranet portals for knowledge sharing, flight manuals, and
operational announcements.
➢ Created automated workflows for leave requests, incident reporting, and crew onboarding using
SharePoint Designer / Power Automate.
➢ Developed SPFx Application Customizers to inject custom banners, notifications, and analytics
across airline intranet portals.
➢ Built SPFx Field Customizers to visually represent operational data (e.g., crew status, flight status)
in SharePoint lists.
➢ Implemented SPFx Command Sets for bulk operations like exporting passenger manifests or
triggering workflows.
➢ Integrated SPFx Extensions with REST APIs, Microsoft Graph, and custom .NET services.
➢ Managed ALM for SPFx solutions using Azure DevOps pipelines for CI/CDOptimized existing .NET
applications for performance, scalability, and security, ensuring compliance with airline IT
policies.
➢ Collaborated with business analysts and airline operations teams to gather requirements and
deliver tailored solutions.
➢ Migrated legacy airline applications into modern SharePoint and .NET frameworks, improving
system reliability and user adoption.
➢ Provided production support and maintenance for critical internal airline applications, ensuring
minimal downtime.
➢ Designed and developed Canvas Apps and Model-Driven Apps in Power Apps to digitize airline/
internal processes such as crew management, compliance tracking, and operational reporting.
➢ Implemented SQL Server, and SharePoint as data sources, ensuring scalable and secure storage
solutions.
➢ Created custom connectors to integrate with REST APIs, WCF services, and Azure Logic Apps,
enabling seamless data flow between internal .NET applications and Power Platform.
➢ Automated workflows and business processes using Power Automate (Flow), including approval
flows, notifications, and system-to-system integrations.
➢ Applied role-based security and environment governance policies for managing app access
and compliance in enterprise setups.
➢ Developed reusable components and templates for faster delivery of multiple apps across airline
business units.
➢ Embedded Power BI dashboards into Power Apps for interactive data visualization and real-time
operational insights.
➢ Worked on ALM (Application Lifecycle Management) for Power Platform using Solutions, Azure
DevOps pipelines, and GIT repositories.
➢ Implemented offline capability in Power Apps for crew operations requiring mobility with
intermittent connectivity.
➢ Collaborated with business users to gather requirements, design wireframes, and conduct UAT
sessions, ensuring adoption and usability.
➢ Optimized app performance using delegation-aware queries, proper data source design, and
formula best practices.
➢ Extended Power Apps functionality using Power Fx formulas, JavaScript, PCF (Power Apps
Component Framework) controls, and custom APIs.
➢ Supported governance and monitoring by configuring Power Platform Admin Center, DLP (Data
Loss Prevention) policies, and analytics.

Power app developer

➢ Automated workflows with Power Automate for approval processes, notifications, and data
synchronization.
➢ Developed custom connectors to integrate external APIs and Azure services (Logic Apps,

Description: The Project is for Chennai Metro Rail Ltd, It is Government agent connected with Railways
Department in India. It’s a Document Management System where documents flows to several
department and goes for an approved process. The Contractor uploads the documents in DMS and
submits to the respected department. The task is assigned to the internal team and they review these
documents and goes for approval process. Once the flow is completed based on the time interval
expiration policy is applied to the documents and they are disposed from the site. A report generation
based on documents uploaded statistics, department-wise reports, Contractor reports,
Responsibilities:
➢ As a developer involved in design and developing the application using SharePoint 2010
➢ Query the data from Generic Collections list using Linq and Loop Expression
➢ Involved in developing custom Timer Jobs, custom document
Expiration policy.
➢ Involved in developing custom sequential workflow and jquery webparts

controls was used in displaying rows of data in a customized template format.
➢ Used Generic Collections to retrieve the data
➢ Involved in configuring Search Service and Content database and SharePoint Service database
movements.
Project Name: LNT IDPL | 1 year
Client
LNT IDPL – Chennai, India.
Role
SharePoint Development & Administration
Team Size
Technologies
SharePoint 2010, SQL Server 2008 Enterprise & Express, C#.net
Description: The application is for LNT IDPL. It’s approval workflow where users submits their request in the
board proposal along with the attachments and submits to approvers. The approver will review the users
request and either forward to LS Head or rejects. The rejected proposals goes back to The approved
proposals will move to Legal & Secretarial Head, either the LS Head can close the proposal or further
move its legal and secretarial independent body. After their review the proposal can either approves or
rejects and sends that status back to LS head. Finally LS Head will close the proposal based on the status
of independent body. The dashboard serves to count the incoming task proposals to each department.
It composes of two module where first module is dedicated to Board proposal, True copy and other
services and second module is a legal workflow.
Responsibilities:
➢ Involved in Page design ASP.net page development
➢ Involved in configuring Enterprise search and User Profile and MySite.
➢ Developed various custom webparts, branding, and UI Customization.
➢ Data binding was extensively used to bind various controls to the data from database. Grid View
controls was used in displaying rows of data in a customized template format.
➢ Involved in using ADO.NET to retrieve and send data to database.
➢ Developed SQL stored procedures and functions to interact with the database.
➢ Involved in Unit/Integration testing various modules of the project.
